errors.text_span: По вертикалната ос са изброени шест стереотипа
errors.evidence: The description states there are six stereotypes, but the vertical axis clearly lists seven categories (numbered 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15).
The description states the stereotypes are numbered 7 to 15, which implies sequential numbering. The actual numbers are 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, which are non-sequential.

errors.text_span: и визуално са подчертани чрез различните цветове
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are visually emphasized by the different colors. In this context, the colors are used to differentiate the data series as defined in the legend, not to provide special emphasis to any particular bar or group.
